# opnsense_tailscale_authentication (Resource)

Tailscale login settings (**VPN ▸ Tailscale ▸ Authentication**, plugin `os-tailscale`): coordination server and pre-authentication key. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `tailscale_authentication` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_tailscale_authentication.this
  id = "tailscale_authentication"
}

resource "opnsense_tailscale_authentication" "this" {
  login_server = "https://controlplane.tailscale.com"
  pre_auth_key = var.tailscale_auth_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `login_server` (String) Coordination server URL, e.g. a Headscale instance.
- `pre_auth_key` (String, Sensitive) Pre-authentication key used to join the tailnet.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `tailscale_authentication`.
